name: Jumilla
terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

notes: It gives broad, fleshy wines with good alcohol and acidity, ripe fruit and well-integrated tannin.
The reds run from violet to brick red, with red and black fruit, and are tannic.
Other grapes add color stability, acidity and aging potential.
Sweet and fortified Monastrell wines add dried fruit notes.

blurb.text: A DO across northern Murcia and southeastern Albacete. Allowed grapes include Monastrell, Tempranillo, Syrah, Garnacha Tinta and Cabernet Sauvignon.
